title: HFF/CLASH Controlled Lensing/X-ray Cross-Readout Enrichment Audit
description: Public reproducibility package for Paper 6, an observational audit of controlled lensing/X-ray cross-readout enrichment in HFF and external CLASH clusters. The package contains manuscript source, rendered PDF, arXiv source package, derived artifacts, scripts, and tests. It is not a proof of Tau Core, not a dark-matter falsification, and not a derived new-gravity mechanism.
notes: The publication-facing result is a controlled enrichment audit under declared controls, not a standalone physical-mechanism claim.
